item.title: Snow women’s basketball closes home schedule with statement sweep
item.description: EPHRAIM — Snow College’s women capped their home schedule with a pair of conference wins that looked very different but carried the same result. item.title: Overhauled Mt. Pleasant Maverik to reopen March 13
item.description: MT. PLEASANT — Maverik plans to reopen its Mt. Pleasant location at 381 S. State St. on Friday, March 13, following an approximate one-month closure for remodeling. item.description: MORONI—A Moroni city councilwoman is leading an effort to combine the one-time Mudd Boggs arena and nearby trap shooting range into an attractive recreation facility. “We want to make it something the community can enjoy that can also bring in revenue,” says Councilwoman Cherrie Green. item.description: MANTI — Students at Manti High School helped brighten Valentine’s Day for local veterans with handwritten messages that were displayed at American Legion Post 31 during a community dinner. item.description: OREM — Gunnison Valley kept its season alive Monday with a 65-62 win over North Summit in the 2A state quarterfinals at Utah Valley University. item.title: Manti speech and debate claims region title; North Sanpete comes in second
item.description: MT. PLEASANT — Manti High School captured the Region Speech and Debate Championship on Saturday at North Sanpete High School, finishing with 121 sweepstakes points.
